channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: A new durability check called guard‑5 was added to the blockchain, and test work for live scenarios was performed. The SDK scaffolding received overrides for user lists and new role seeds, and third‑party resolution settings were updated. Repositories: SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: A merge issue in the blockchain code was fixed, and additional test work was added to align marker handling. Repositories: SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Temporary diagnostic prints were added to the wallet verification process, and the diagnostics were enhanced. Repositories: GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A roadmap for the next version of the network was created, and backup notes for the database were rewritten. Repositories: GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An old GQHSM submodule was removed from two AI projects and the documentation was updated accordingly. The blockchain storage system was improved to keep seal markers during cleanup, and database backup handling was upgraded. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: New investor scenarios for wire lockouts and warrant resale were added, and scripts were fixed to handle dollar values correctly. The SDK introduced a payout address feature and switched to self‑hosted build runners, and a new numeric keypad component was added to a client scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusWallet, libp2p.
